text: Men jippinirii Deftere Alqur'aana nden, e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, fii yimɓe ɓen, e hoore goonga, no jertiniraaɓe. Kala feewuɗo, ko hoore makko o feewani, Allah nafitortaa peewal makko, tawde ko O yondiniiɗo e ɗum; kala kadi majjuɗo, haray lorra mun on, ko e makko yiltotoo, ɗum lorrataa Allah. A wonaali wakkilaaɗo ɓee, fii daranagol ɓe haa ɓe feewa. Ko yottingol tun, fawi maa e maɓɓe.
